item.title: ‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KHÉPHREN THURAM — TARGETING MID-JANUARY RETURN Khé…
item.description: ‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KHÉPHREN THURAM — TARGETING MID-JANUARY RETURN Khéphren Thuram has completed his rehabilitation programme at J-Medical and is expected to return to training at Continassa next week. The French midfielder will initially work in the gym before gradually returning to running exercises on the pitch. Following the Christmas break and a medical consultation in France, Spalletti hopes to have Thuram available by mid-January, potentially for the match against Genoa. However, the Juventus medical staff remain determined to exercise maximum caution throughout his recovery. 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — tuttosport

item.title: ‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: MANUEL LOCATELLI — NOT EXPECTED BACK BEFORE MARCH …
item.description: ‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: MANUEL LOCATELLI — NOT EXPECTED BACK BEFORE MARCH Juventus captain Manuel Locatelli continues to struggle with the effects of his meniscus injury. The Italian midfielder is not expected to return to full team training before March, leaving Spalletti without an important midfield option for an extended period. As a result, Juventus are reportedly considering a third signing during the January transfer window. The club could look to recruit a ready-made deep-lying playmaker capable of organising the midfield alongside Douglas Luiz, providing an immediate solution during Locatelli's absence. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮— tuttosport

item.title: ‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KENAN YILDIZ - RETURN TARGETED FOR 3rd JANUARY Ken…
item.description: ‼️ 🏥 JUVENTUS INJURY UPDATE: KENAN YILDIZ - RETURN TARGETED FOR 3rd JANUARY Kenan Yildiz has already spent two weeks completing individual training sessions with the ball, providing encouraging signs in his recovery. Despite the positive progress, Juventus have decided not to rush him back for the match against Monza on 14 December. Instead, the Bianconeri have reportedly identified the away fixture against Bologna on 3 January 2027 as his target return date. The priority remains ensuring Yildiz is fully recovered before returning to competitive action. ⚪️ ⚫️ 𝓢𝓸𝓾𝓻𝓬𝓮 — tuttosport

item.title: 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti’s #JuveVenezia press conference: • Kalulu and Nico Gonzále…
item.description: 🎙️ Luciano Spalletti’s #JuveVenezia press conference: • Kalulu and Nico González will not be available. • Conceição will be assessed. Sooner or later, he’ll be back on the pitch. • Woltemade feels comfortable playing in his new role. I’m convinced he’ll succeed. • Ekhator is an important prospect. I hope he continues improving his physical condition. • I really don’t understand why there’s so much fuss about Zidane and Conte’s comments. • I’m preparing for this 600th match with exactly the same excitement I felt before my first. • Spoke to McKennie after his interview, I didn’t get the impression that he wanted to leave. • Gatti is trying to add something more to his game beyond simply defending. • We’ll face a side that plays very vertically. As soon as they regain possession, they immediately look to attack the space behind the opposition.
